description: Splitting a TMA solution's leg before or after one of its fixes (product owner, 27 Oct 2026, the Outline's Split before and Split after): before, the fix is the first fix of a new leg; after, it is the last fix of the earlier leg, the next fix starting the new one. The legs already there keep their fixes (leg_starts gains one time; nothing moves). Refused when the fix already starts a leg, or is the solution's first, before (first); when it already ends a leg, or is the solution's last, after (last); or when the leg would keep fewer than two fixes either side of the split (few, with how many before and after). leg is the leg holding the fix, from 1; a leg starts at the first fix at or after its start time. Held by python/debrief-stac/tests/test_tma.py (debrief_stac.tma.split_at_fix_index) and vscode/test/unit/tma.test.ts (vscode/webview/tma.ts splitAtFix).

cases.name: before a fix in the middle of one leg
after a fix in the middle of one leg
before its second fix: one fix would be left before
after its last fix but one: one fix would be left after
before a fix that already starts a leg
after a fix that already ends a leg
before, in the first of two legs: the later leg kept
after, in the second of two legs
before, in the second leg: one fix of it would be left before
a leg starting between fixes starts at the next fix
after the fix before a leg starting between fixes
